findings.body: The new sequential-launch proof exposes a running state that stop handles incorrectly: tests/test_lanes_agents.py:170–197 holds a Git subprocess between model launches and confirms that the entry now records the Forge parent. Here the comparison passes group=False; codex._stop then signals only that parent on POSIX (src/forge/codex.py:645–648). Its Git subprocess and any hooks remain alive, while stop can remove the entry once the parent is reaped. A blocked subprocess makes this an unbounded state, not merely a subsecond spawn window. End the verified run's complete tree before releasing admission and cover stopping the parent-held state in the command test. The advisory legacy variant also remains: tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533 launches an ungrouped child, but this comparison passes group=True, so stop targets a nonexistent group and cannot stop it.
findings.title: Not done: forge stop ends a named running or waiting run in either lane and frees its place

findings.body: This previous gap remains open. Admission snapshots chosen, but Autoreview's defaults and fallback update only selected and activity progress at review.py:603–611. The worker's Claude-to-Codex fallback similarly replaces chosen at worker.py:165 without updating the entry. Both reader paths join using repo.models at story.py:222 and :230, which returns an empty selection when unconfigured (src/forge/repo.py:411–419); subsequent Claude and Codex selection events update only activity records (repo.py:278–283 and codex.py:384–386). Board lanes can therefore show null or the previous model/effort throughout an actual run. Refresh the shared entry when selection becomes known or changes across these callers.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the provider selects its model and effort

findings.body: Test commands still bypass the shared entries: src/forge/fasttest.py:271 launches directly, and src/forge/review.py:279–288 uses the separate ticket queue. Consequently, board cannot expose running tests' lane output/progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or end an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:142 assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice for that task rather than an AGENTS blocker.
